content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Insurance carrier earning premiums and annuity deposits; it does not manage investment assets for fees like the target."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning commissions from carriers; it places policies rather than managing investment portfolios."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Asset manager running mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts for advisors and institutions, earning asset-based fees, like the target."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Financial data and analytics software sold by subscription; it does not manage investment assets or run funds."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Asset manager earning fees from mutual funds, closed-end funds and separate accounts for institutions and individuals."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Asset manager sponsoring real asset and other funds and separate accounts for institutions, earning management and performance fees."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Operates OTC trading venues and sells market data and disclosure services; it does not manage investment portfolios."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment manager running separate accounts and pooled funds, though it focuses on wealthy individuals and families."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Software and outsourced back-office operations for financial firms; it does not manage investments or sponsor funds."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage and program administration earning carrier commissions; a different business from managing investments."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Multi-boutique asset manager sponsoring mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts, sold through advisers to individuals and institutions."}]}
